confirm-readme.title: alex's screen does not lock reliably
confirm-readme.detail:
For alex: the screen never locks by itself; it does not lock when waking from sleep.
An unlocked desktop gives anyone who walks by your browser sessions, chats and
files. Games and videos in fullscreen keep the screen awake on their own, so
auto-lock does not interrupt them.

affects.name: Controller-only play and watching videos
affects.where: in use here: Steam is installed
affects.sentence: The screen can lock while you play with only a controller or watch a video, if that app does not keep the screen awake.

confirm-readme.commands:
runuser -u alex -- kwriteconfig6 --file kscreenlockerrc --group Daemon --key Autolock --type bool true
runuser -u alex -- kwriteconfig6 --file kscreenlockerrc --group Daemon --key LockOnResume --type bool true
runuser -u alex -- env DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus busctl --user call org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver /ScreenSaver org.kde.screensaver configure >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
confirm-readme.note: If the change does not show up right away, it applies at the next login.
